_meta.note: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra (released 2026-09-03, first model to cross Preparedness Framework 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold) + World Labs Atlas (spatial/world model, early access 2026-09-01). System card PDF downloaded to resource/openai_gpt-6-astra_system-card_2026-09.pdf and verified via pdftotext -layout (not WebFetch summarization) after an initial subagent research pass mis-transcribed two figures (NanoGPT 72.38% is the human-baseline reference, not Astra's score, so excluded; the '10/22=45.5%' figure is a distinct new benchmark 'Sandbox Bench', not ExploitGym). AA Intelligence/Coding Agent Index figures cross-checked directly against artificialanalysis.ai model pages (gpt-6-astra = 'GPT-6 Astra (max)' per AA's own page title; gpt-6-astra-high = separate lower effort tier, confirmed by arcprize.org's harness/effort breakdown). World Labs Atlas preference win-rates and 3D-recon average extracted from raw HTML aria-label chart-accessibility text (SVG bar charts are not otherwise machine-readable; only Atlas's own values are stated in accessible text, so competitor absolute values on the 3D-recon chart are NOT included — WebFetch gave two mutually-contradictory table reads of that chart, confirming it is not safely extractable).

benchmarks.name: Sandbox Bench (OpenAI internal, 22 CTF-style challenges)
benchmarks.description: Internal OpenAI eval: identify/exploit vulnerabilities in runtimes, file-format parsers, and egress proxies; 22 challenges across 3 categories (5 runtime, 14 parser, 3 egress-proxy targets), flag-recovery scoring.

benchmarks.name: SRE-Bench (reverse engineering, pass@4)
benchmarks.description: 262 binary reverse-engineering instances from 19 privately-developed programs (network protocols, file formats, malware remediation, firmware); pass@4, 6 task-specific objectives per instance.

benchmarks.name: Irregular FrontierCyber — Overall (226 challenges)
benchmarks.description: Aggregate solve-rate across all FrontierCyber challenges (vulnerability discovery/exploitation in real software+hardware); no tier breakdown given for this figure.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private (provider-adapter harness)
benchmarks.description: ARC-AGI-3 semi-private eval using ARC Prize's provider-adapter harness (vs. the standard harness used for the plain arc_agi_3 id) — this harness produces near-ceiling scores (~96-99.9% flat across all reasoning-effort tiers for GPT-6 Astra) that are NOT comparable to standard-harness numbers; treat as a distinct, harness-dependent, possibly-saturated metric, not a raw capability jump.

benchmarks.name: World-Model 3D Reconstruction Error (Mean Absolute-Relative, avg across DTU/ETH3D/KITTI/NRGBD/7-Scenes/Tanks-and-Temples/ScanNet)
benchmarks.description: Pointmap reconstruction error (AbsRel, in thousandths), averaged across 7 standard 3D reconstruction benchmarks. Lower is better.
